candidates.title: Project Coordinator
candidates.abstract: Coordinate drawings, procurement, scheduling, temporary works, QA / ITPs and documentation across Tigerform construction projects. Office based role.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a project coordinator?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
How many years' experience do you have as an Estimating Coordinator?
candidates.content_text:
About the role
As a Project Coordinator at Tigerform, you will play a vital role in ensuring the successful delivery of construction projects. Responsible for overseeing shop drawings, assisting with procurement and scheduling, liaising with consultants and clients, coordinating temporary works, quality assurance and project documentation, this full-time position based in Moorabbin, Victoria, is essential to the company's operations.
What you'll be doing
- Coordinate and manage shop drawings from issue through to approval.
- Review drawings for missing information, clashes, inconsistencies, and site coordination issues.
- Liaise with engineers, architects, consultants, builders, suppliers, and subcontractors.
- Assist with procurement planning for materials such as precast, formwork items, reinforcement, PT, temporary works, and site requirements.
- Track procurement dates to ensure materials and subcontractor inputs are available when required.
- Assist with project programming and scheduling.
- Help prepare and maintain lookahead programs and key milestone trackers.
- Coordinate temporary works requirements, including propping, screens, crane/lift planning, platforms, backpropping, and engineering sign-offs.
- Follow up outstanding information, RFIs, approvals, and documentation.
- Assist with preparing and tracking RFIs.
- Support the team with variations, including identifying scope changes and gathering backup information.
- Maintain project document registers and ensure current drawings and documents are issued to site.
- Assist with quality assurance documentation, including ITPs, checklists, inspections, photos, and close-out records.
- Help ensure project teams are working from the latest approved drawings and information.
- Coordinate with site teams to resolve practical construction issues.
What we're looking for
- Good attitude
- Proven experience as a Project Coordinator or similar role in the construction industry
- Strong project management skills, including the ability to develop and track project plans
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with diverse stakeholders
- Proficient in the use of project management software and tools
- Adaptable and able to work well in a team environment
- Solid understanding of construction processes
What we offer
At Tigerform Pty Ltd, we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. You'll enjoy a competitive salary with opportunities for professional development
About us
Tigerform is a leading commercial concrete structure company with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality projects.

candidates.content_text:
Keller Graduate Program – 2027
Intake, to commence February 22027
- Australia’s leading geotechnical engineering company
- Mentoring program with colleagues who are experts in their field
- Contribute to major projects and building the future of Australia
About Keller Australia
We have delivered industry leading foundations and ground improvement solutions to the building, construction, and mining industries in Australia for over 60 years. With a wide range of challenging and dynamic projects, join Keller to build the foundations for the future of Australia and we can help you build your career. 
Who are we looking for?
We are on the lookout for a recent or upcoming Civil Engineering Graduate to join the Keller family as part of our 2-year Graduate Program. This unique opportunity gives Graduates hands on experience across all aspects of our organisation and equips you with real life skills to kick start your career in engineering.
The best part? At the end of the program, permanent positions are considered as part of the Keller Engineering Team!
What does the program entail?
2-year training across Pre-Construction and Operations
Membership with Engineers Australia as part of their Graduate Program 
Experience in assisting on major projects throughout Australia  
What will make you a good fit for our team?
- You are a recent Engineering Graduate (within the last 2 years) in Civil or Geotechnical Engineering 
- You have a passion for the industry and looking to get firsthand exposure to all aspects of an organisation 
- You are willing to travel, our graduate program will allow you to visit our various offices and projects sites across Australia, giving you valuable hands-on experience and firsthand knowledge from our expert team 
- You have your Australian Drivers License and your own transport
- You can commit to 2 years full-time employment within the program
- You have full, unrestricted working rights in Australia
What makes us stand out?
- Our culture - We are a diverse and inclusive organisation where differences are valued. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities to apply
- Our projects – We employ a variety of geotechnical techniques across a range of interesting projects across the country 
- Our expertise – Our team have a broad range of skills with vast experience within the industry, and they are eager to mentor and assist with career development
How to apply
If you love what you have heard and are ready to join the Keller Team, apply online today with your CV, covering letter and a copy of your academic transcript. 
To learn more about us, visit www.keller.com.au
Please note Keller have a strong commitment to health and safety, a pre-employment medical (including a drug and alcohol screen) will be required for the successful candidate.
